data.description:
## Reproduction Steps

The Reconciler Heartbeat Canary (reconcile-bridge-canary.yml) detected that
reconcile-bridge.yml has not completed a successful run within the
4-hour window (bridge cadence: hourly). Inspect the Actions tab.

## Expected vs Actual

- **Expected:** reconcile-bridge.yml completes a successful run at least once
  every 4h.
- **Actual:** Reconciler unhealthy — canonical status is FAILED.
- **First red canary run:** 2026-09-05T02:13:47Z
- **Detected at:** 2026-09-05T04:11:09Z (second consecutive red canary run)
- **Canary run:** https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33943735000

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] reconcile-bridge.yml is running and its most recent run succeeded.
- [ ] Root cause identified (workflow disabled / runner outage / acli auth /
      Jira creds / reconciler error) and addressed.

This ticket auto-closes when the next successful reconcile-bridge run is detected.
